description: Switch CardputerZero between the desktop and a lean server mode

store.summary: Stop the desktop and extra services to free RAM, and start them again with one key
store.description: Server Mode stops the Raspberry Pi desktop and services that a headless board does not need (printing, PackageKit, portals, accounts, NFS) and keeps the CardputerZero screen, Wi-Fi, ssh and Bluetooth. Press Enter again to start the desktop. The Settings page selects the groups to stop and changes boot options (GPU memory, HDMI, camera, cloud-init, boot into server mode). Every change is reversible.
